query_analysis.original_query: Our PSA system is showing inefficient cycling due to delays in valve actuation. What control upgrades would you recommend to optimize adsorption/desorption timing?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Identify and recommend control system upgrades to mitigate valve actuation delays causing inefficient cycling in our Pressure Swing Adsorption (PSA) system, with the goal of optimizing adsorption and desorption timing.

communication_strategy.information_flow: Collaborative identification of control upgrades and synchronization of valve actuation
communication_strategy.collaboration_protocol: Integrated control strategy development and iterative optimization

clarification_questions: Can you provide details on the current control system configuration and valve types?
Have there been recent changes to the PSA system or operating conditions?
What are the specific timings and delays observed in valve actuation?
